result_text:
Both defects are fixed in the `reports` module, with a regression test for the group-link merge. The module's tests pass (2 tests, including the new one). Nothing is committed.

1. **Group Dependencies NPE**: in `ComponentGroupsUtils.getGroupDependencies`, the reverse-direction branch read `key1` instead of `key2`. `key1` was never in the map, so `get` returned null. Both sides now use `key2`, so the reverse dependency adds its count to the existing group link. Your example gives one link from "Group 1 (2)" to "Group 2 (2)" labelled 5.
2. **"2147483647%" / NaN in the details table**: in `ComponentDependenciesDetailsRenderer.getFromDependencyCoverageSvg`, the percentage is now 0 when the referring component's LOC is 0. The text shows "0%", and the bar gets the existing 1px minimum from `SimpleOneBarChart.getPercentageSvg`.

I also added `reports/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/generators/statichtml/ComponentGroupsUtilsTest.java`, which covers the reverse-direction merge. The zero-LOC guard has no test; it is a one-line change I checked by reading the code.
